entities.name: Sidney H. Haughton

entities.summary: Sidney Henry Haughton FRS was an English-born South African paleontologist and geologist best known for his description of the sauropodomorph dinosaur Melanorosaurus in 1924, and his work on the geology of the Witwatersrand.
